description: Notices about environmental permits that Dutch municipalities publish in their Gemeenteblad, served as XML records by the SRU search interface of the government's official publications repository.
name: Official publications of environmental permit notices (Netherlands)

recipe.reason: The source is an SRU search interface whose Gemeenteblad environmental permit notices are a result set of well over a million records, while the interface serves at most 100 records a request and none past the 10,000th of a result set; a fetch would have to split the query by date into hundreds of windows and make more than ten thousand requests for gigabytes of XML, which no recipe reads, and a single window of the set is not this dataset.
